parameters: Static identifiers, strings, integers, booleans, paths or declarative expressions only.
description: Groups RMT declarations into one app or feature source of truth.

diagnostics: Top-level operations are rejected; put work in surface/lane.

parameters: Static identifiers, strings, integers, booleans, paths or declarative expressions only.
description: Loads static RMT source only; no dynamic expressions.
validExample: import "./routes/*.rmt"
diagnostics: Dynamic imports are not part of RMT vNext.

syntax: state app.status type object preserve { initial { text "Ready" } }
parameters: Static identifiers, strings, integers, booleans, paths or declarative expressions only.
description: Declares owned application state.

diagnostics: State needs a static type.

syntax: selector app.view from state app.status { output StatusView }
parameters: Static identifiers, strings, integers, booleans, paths or declarative expressions only.
description: Derives view-models without host JavaScript.

diagnostics: Selectors need a static source.

syntax: datasource items from endpoint "/api/items" { method GET result list }
parameters: Static identifiers, strings, integers, booleans, paths or declarative expressions only.
description: Declares host-owned data access.
validExample: datasource tickets from endpoint "/api/tickets" { method GET result list fallback fixture tickets.empty }
diagnostics: Free function calls are refused.

syntax: resource app.timer kind timer owner surface.app { dispose on surface.destroy }
parameters: Static identifiers, strings, integers, booleans, paths or declarative expressions only.
description: Declares owner-scoped resources with cleanup.
validExample: resource app.stream kind stream owner surface.shell { dispose on surface.destroy }

parameters: Static identifiers, strings, integers, booleans, paths or declarative expressions only.

parameters: Static identifiers, strings, integers, booleans, paths or declarative expressions only.
description: Declares UI surfaces and their component capability.
validExample: surface dashboard kind page component x-section { lane visible { hydrate status.card } }

parameters: Static identifiers, strings, integers, booleans, paths or declarative expressions only.

parameters: Static identifiers, strings, integers, booleans, paths or declarative expressions only.

parameters: Static identifiers, strings, integers, booleans, paths or declarative expressions only.

parameters: Static identifiers, strings, integers, booleans, paths or declarative expressions only.

parameters: Static identifiers, strings, integers, booleans, paths or declarative expressions only.

parameters: Static identifiers, strings, integers, booleans, paths or declarative expressions only.

parameters: Static identifiers, strings, integers, booleans, paths or declarative expressions only.

parameters: Static identifiers, strings, integers, booleans, paths or declarative expressions only.
